outcome.technical: Fixed the page-widening invariant structurally rather than by the trade-offs the brief's three options named, because the files in scope (tables.css, shell.css, check-report-interactive.mjs, test_render_report.py) rule out touching the renderer (option b's <wbr> half) or report.js (option c's JS-measured fallback), and dropping viewport-sticky at every width (option a) would have broken the already-shipped, already-tested sticky-header stack (the --sticky-3/--z-thead chain pinned in test_render_report.py) for no gain the title asks for. Root cause confirmed by reading shell.css: `.content :where(table){overflow-wrap:break-word}` already covers every table cell, but `break-word` (unlike `anywhere`) does not shrink a cell's MIN-CONTENT width in the table column-sizing algorithm - which is why break-word was already universal and the bugs table still overflowed. P126.1's fix (`table.bugs td.tevcell,table.bugs td.tevcell *{white-space:normal}`) only worked because real status words contain hyphens the browser can break at under `white-space:normal`; it does nothing for a genuinely unbroken run. Added one general rule to tables.css: `:where(table.phases,table.data) :is(.chip,.rchip,.bandpill,.dl,.heldby,.tevn,.tevf,.ptev){white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}` - every status/value atom a table carries outside a title now has its min-content width reducible to a single character, so no one atom's length (hyphenated or not) can set its column's floor past the viewport. Title cells are deliberately excluded (classless `td`, untouched): overflow-wrap:anywhere there is the documented regression (ordinary words splitting mid-letter) the comment above the colspan rule already warns about; titles keep the renderer's <wbr> approach. Updated shell.css's comment on the break-word rule to name the exception tables.css now carves out of it, so the two files stay honest about each other. Added a Python pin (test_render_report.py, case u14ktw) asserting the new selector and declaration are present in the assembled _CSS; all 298 cases in that file's own --selftest pass, including u14ktw. Added a browser-gate case (tools/check-report-interactive.mjs, section 10c, after 10b) that forces a monospace fallback font via page.addStyleTag, plants a 160-char run with no space or hyphen into one atom of each of .chip/.rchip/.bandpill/.dl/.heldby/.tevn/.tevf/.ptev found on the fixture, at FRAMED_BELOW+1 (833px, the narrowest unframed width), and asserts document.scrollWidth does not exceed clientWidth - plus a liveness assertion that the planted atoms were actually painted, so a selector that resolved to nothing could not pass for free; the assertion that proves the invariant visually is the `expect('an unbroken run with no space or hyphen, planted into every status/value atom ..., widens nothing at the narrowest unframed width (833px) under a monospace fallback', ...)` call in that new section, which the orchestrator should run against a freshly re-rendered examples/acme-store/acme-store-audit.html. `node --check` on the file passes. Verified non-browser gates in my tree: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py` -> `330/332 files ok, 152 migrated to tests/, 15569 cases` (reproduced on two separate runs). Two files red: `plugins/audit/tests/test__refs.py` (cases sc1/sc2) and `tools/check-rendered-artifacts.py` (cases ra5/ra5b) - both are artifact-freshness trip-wires correctly firing because the CSS bytes changed: eight committed docs/screenshots/*.png now digest a different report source, and examples/acme-store/acme-store-audit.html plus docs/demo-large.html no longer match a fresh render. None of those four paths are in this task's `files`, and refreshing them needs `node tools/capture-screenshots.mjs` (one of the locked browser tools) and a committed re-render, both outside an executor's scope here - left for the orchestrator's regeneration pass rather than fixed in this tree. `python3 plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/validate-manifest.py docs/audit/audit-plan.json` -> OK (128 phases, 955 tasks, 25 bugs). `claude plugin validate .` and `claude plugin validate plugins/audit` -> both pass. `python3 plugins/audit/scripts/status/audit-status.py docs/audit/audit-plan.json --gate` -> GATE PASSED. `python3 plugins/audit/scripts/report/render-report.py docs/audit/audit-plan.json --out-dir /tmp/audit-report` -> wrote both files with no error. `ruff check plugins/audit tools` -> all checks passed. `vermin -t=3.8- --no-tips --violations plugins/audit/scripts plugins/audit/hooks plugins/audit/tests` -> minimum 3.7, no incompatible versions. Did not run `node tools/check-report-interactive.mjs` or `node tools/capture-screenshots.mjs --check` myself, per this phase's orchestrator instruction that browser gates are machine-wide locked; the orchestrator runs those and should also refresh the now-stale screenshots and re-render/commit the two stale artifacts named above.
outcome.descriptive: No table column can ever be widened past the viewport by a single unbroken run in a status, risk, cost-band, delta or evidence-mark cell - by construction (overflow-wrap:anywhere shrinking the cell's own min-content width), not by which words a plan happens to contain or which fallback font a host draws them in - while titles and the viewport-sticky table header are left exactly as they were.
